subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor the existing explicit `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` opt-in while video submission and image generation remain stricter exceptions?
rationale: The implementation is correct, centralized, default-deny, and well-proven, but it expands the capability scope of a security-sensitive operator option and sibling media behavior is intentionally non-uniform.

options.title: Honor the music opt-in
options.body: Merge this implementation so music follows the established sanitized provider request-policy contract while stricter sibling exceptions remain explicit.

options.title: Keep music deny-private
options.body: Forward headers, authentication, proxy, and TLS settings but retain an explicit false override for private-network access.

recommendation.title: Honor the music opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge this implementation so music follows the established sanitized provider request-policy contract while stricter sibling exceptions remain explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the OpenRouter music capability and are the strongest available owner for its intended network-policy boundary.
